name: Let's Play Fetch!
author: lucasmoten
description: My latest microgame. Let's Play Fetch - From Challenge 2 of Create with Code course on Unity Learn.  ---- A few enhancements: Play tested under default Unity Website Games dimension (1024x580). Only allow spawning a dog after 2 seconds pass. Spawn manager stops spawning once the game is over. Altered farmer outfit by mixing up in available textures as well as a pose on main menu and a different on the game play screen to avoid idle slouching. Dog switches direction when pressing space. 3 scenes (Main Menu, the Challenge, and Game Over). Main menu provides instructional text and start button. Game Over is shown momentarily for a few seconds before returning to the Main Menu. Display of dogs remaining updates and ticks down as a form of "player lives".
